items.title: Dave Marsh, Veteran Rock Critic and Bruce Springsteen Biographer, Dies at 76
items.summary: In a statement, Springsteen called the former Creem editor “soulful, intelligent, heartfelt, opinionated, bruising and often fantastically argumentative”
